other_conditions: Applicant can be an individual, association, society, partnership, self‑help group or company.
Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
Applicant must not be older than 55 years.
Two guarantors are required, one of whom must be a government servant.
Financial support is only for self‑employment activities.
Eligibility criteria may be relaxed by the Board of Directors in deserving cases.
benefits_summary: Provides loan up to ₹10 lakh for individuals and up to ₹15 lakh for groups to undertake self‑employment activities, with a required 10 % margin money contribution.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
